leadText:
Clark (Japanese: ヒュウガ Hyūga) is a character of the day who appeared in Shocks and Bonds. He is a Pokémon Trainer who took part in the Double Battle rounds of the Ever Grande Conference.

Clark was known as "The Conductor", and he used a baton to literally "conduct" his Pokémon in battle. He faced in the third and last of the Trainer's Double Battles. During this battle, Clark sent out his and against Ash's Grovyle and . It appeared that Ash had an overwhelming disadvantage, but he kept his cool. Clark made his Pokémon attack using their various attacks, while Ash had his Pokémon use their best. Eventually, defeated Quilava, but ended up getting knocked out by Charizard's .

Using his , Ash created several ice pillars, preventing Charizard from coming in and attacking directly with its . It also used the pillars to bounce and evade Charizard's moves. Glalie used to take the win, allowing Ash to move on to the next round, while Clark was eliminated from the tournament.
